transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um... well, I suppose things have just gotten a bit overwhelming lately. I've been taking on a lot of work. Probably far more projects and... workshops than I can realistically manage right now. 

I started doing all these studio improvements, taking on extra client calls... and now, well, the deadlines are really starting to close in on me. The mortgage, too. So... yeah. I guess that's why I'm here.
Have you been feeling anxious about your situation?
Anxious? Um... no, I wouldn't really say that. I don't think it's anxiety. It's just... a lot of things to get done. I just need to figure out how to finish it all, I suppose.
Have you been feeling sad or down lately?
No... I wouldn't say that. I haven't really noticed feeling sad. Just... busy, I suppose. There hasn't really been time to sit around feeling down.
Have you been feeling unusually tired lately?
Tired? Um... no, not really. I mean, with everything going on, I haven't really been sleeping much, but... I don't feel tired. I actually feel like I have plenty of energy to keep working.
Are you avoiding any activities or places because of your current situation?
Avoiding places? Um... no. Not that I can think of. I just... I go where I need to go. Mostly I'm just working, so... no, I wouldn't say I'm avoiding anything.
Do you feel like you have to keep working on these projects and tasks even when you don't want to?
No... not really. I want to work on them. It's not like I'm forcing myself to do it against my will. I just... I prefer to keep working.
Do you feel like you're doing these tasks perfectly or is it okay with you if they're not done flawlessly?
Um... I don't really think about it like that. I'm not trying to make it perfect. I just... I just want to get the work done. It's fine if it's not flawless, I guess.
Do you feel a strong urge to start new projects even when your current ones are not finished?
Um... no, not really. I just... I stick to what's in front of me. I don't really feel the need to jump around to new things.
Do you feel like you have to check or recheck your work repeatedly to make sure everything is done correctly?
No... I don't really do that. I mean... once I finish something, I just move on. I don't sit there checking it over and over.
Do you have any recurring thoughts that you can't seem to get out of your head?
No... I don't think so. Nothing like that really gets stuck in my head. I just... focus on whatever I'm working on.
Have you experienced any physical complaints lately, such as headaches or stomach problems?
Um... no. Not really. Physically, I'm... I'm fine. I haven't noticed any headaches or anything like that.
Have you lost interest in things you used to enjoy doing?
No... I still paint. I mean, I haven't really stopped doing the things I usually do. So... no, not really.
Do you have any thoughts that keep repeating in your mind even when you try to focus on something else?
Um... didn't you just ask me something like that? No... I don't. Like I said before, I just... I keep my mind on what I'm doing. Nothing is repeating.
Do you think you might be using work as a way to distract yourself from other things that might be bothering you?
Um... no. I don't think so. I just... I paint because that's what I do. It's my work. I'm not trying to distract myself from anything.
Do you feel like you're able to complete tasks as efficiently as you used to?
I suppose so. I mean... my paintings get finished. It just takes the time it takes, really. I haven't noticed any changes.
Do you think your workload has increased as a way to deal with stress or difficult emotions in your personal life?
No, not really. I just... I paint. It's just what I do. I don't think it has anything to do with... stress.
Do you feel like you're able to experience a full range of emotions, like happiness or sadness, when something good or bad happens to you?
I don't know. I guess so. I mean... I feel things like anyone else. I haven't really thought about it.
Do you feel like you're able to cry or feel strong emotions when something very sad happens to you?
I suppose so. I haven't really... had a reason to cry lately. I just react how anyone would, I guess. I don't really dwell on it.
Do you feel like you're able to feel emotions as strongly as you used to?
I mean... I think so. I haven't really noticed any difference. I don't really sit around measuring how strong my feelings are... they just feel normal, I guess.
Do you feel like you're able to feel love or affection for your friends and family as strongly as you used to?
I mean... yeah, of course. I care about them just the same. It's... not really something that's changed.
